description: This file contains utility functions for loading and managing test projects and test files in the Playwright test runner, including project collection, test file loading, suite creation, filtering, and source map handling.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used for organizing tests and suites.

methods.name: collectProjectsAndTestFiles
methods.description: Collects project files and sets up project suites based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: loadFileSuites
methods.description: Loads test files into suites, manages dependencies, and populates project suites.

methods.name: createRootSuite
methods.description: Creates the root suite with project and test filtering, sharding, and 'only' filtering applied.

methods.name: loadGlobalHook
methods.description: Loads a global hook script for the test environment.

methods.name: loadReporter
methods.description: Loads a reporter module for test reporting.

methods.name: loadTestList
methods.description: Loads a list of tests from a file and creates a filter function.
